{{Quote|I’ve now downloaded into the court’s evidentiary computer a report by Lieutenant Corran Horn that I would like entered into evidence as People’s exhibit 34. You have reviewed this report?|Halla Ettyk|<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}

The '''People's Exhibit 34''' was the report that [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] filed during the Rogues' mission to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] of Rogue [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], prosecutor [[Halla Ettyk]] used the report as evidence.<ref name="KT" />

In the report, Horn reported that he saw Celchu meeting with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]] on a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] called [[The Headquarters]].<ref name="KT" />
